violations.msg: DNP intent for the THT headers lives only in a custom 'Variant=DNP' field and the value string - the KiCad-native dnp attribute is absent (in_bom yes), so native BOM/POS exports will emit them as populate lines unless P9's BOM writer filters the custom field.

guidance: (1) SCHEMATIC: give J3 and J4 KiCad's NATIVE dnp attribute. Keep on_board = yes (the lands must exist on the PCB) and keep in_bom = yes (they belong in the documentation BOM). Make the change in the GENERATOR kicad/gen/main_sheet.py so a rebuild reproduces it, then rebuild main.kicad_sch through that generator (and re-stitch the root with kicad/gen/root.py if the root build is what produces g0-sense.kicad_sch). Do NOT hand-edit any .kicad_sch text. Leave the existing 'Variant=DNP' field and the '(DNP)' value suffix in place - belt and braces.

(2) PARTS: in boards/g0-sense/parts/parts.json, on the line whose mpn is 'HX PZ2.54-1x4P ZZ' (the 1x4 2.54 mm header used for J3 SWD and J4 UART), add "refdes_class": {"J3": "hand_install", "J4": "hand_install"} and "refdes_notes": {"J3": "<one line>", "J4": "<one line>"} saying THT, not machine-placeable by JLC economy PCBA (SMT-only), hand-solder after reflow. hand_install is the intended class (bought, fitted by hand; BOM-full only, never in the assembler upload or CPL) - see the assembly-class table at the top of .claude/skills/ai-ee/scripts/bom_cpl.py. Change nothing else in parts.json.

PROOF OF NO COLLATERAL DAMAGE (required): export the netlist BEFORE your change to a temp path (kc.py netlist), export it again AFTER, and run netlist_audit.py --netlist <after> --compare <before>. Report the diff. Any electrical difference other than DNP/attribute metadata is a regression - restore the snapshot 'pre-fix-review-w3' and report failure.
Then run kc.py erc on the top schematic and confirm 0 errors / 0 warnings. Report the counts. Do NOT run gate.py --workspace (the orchestrator records the gate).
